We have retrieved polymorphs for many compositions, but some failed (ZnN, K3N, YbN). Also some path errors due to typos (ccorral). Need to ensure we include all successful compositions (list of successful_compositions from batch result). That list includes many (around 40). However some file paths may be wrong due to typos in our composition_files dict. We need to correct paths for those with wrong directories (ccorral). Let's list which compositions have wrong paths: InN path has "/ccorral/". MoN path has "/ccorral_fixes/". NiN path has "/ccorral_fixes/". Ca3N2 path has "/ccorral/". Na3N path has "/ccorral_fixes/". So many paths are wrong. Need to correct them to the proper directory: "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/7/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_9/". Let's construct corrected composition_files dict using successful compositions list.

We can retrieve list of successful compositions from batch result: they are in result JSON. Let's extract that list. Use tool? Could just manually copy from earlier output. The successful list includes: AlN, GaN, InN, Si3N4, BN, TiN, ZrN, HfN, NbN, TaN, MoN, WN, CrN, FeN, CoN, NiN, CuN, Mg3N2, Ca3N2, Sr3N2, Ba3N2, Li3N, Na3N, ScN, YN, LaN, CeN, PrN, NdN, SmN, EuN, GdN, TbN, DyN, HoN, ErN, TmN, LuN. That's 40? Let's count: I'll count: 1 AlN,2 GaN,3 InN,4 Si3N4,5 BN,6 TiN,7 ZrN,8 HfN,9 NbN,10 TaN,11 MoN,12 WN,13 CrN,14 FeN,15 CoN,16 NiN,17 CuN,18 Mg3N2,19 Ca3N2,20 Sr3N2,21 Ba3N2,22 Li3N,23 Na3N,24 ScN,25 YN,26 LaN,27 CeN,28 PrN,29 NdN,30 SmN,31 EuN,32 GdN,33 TbN,34 DyN,35 HoN,36 ErN,37 TmN,38 LuN. Now we need to consolidate all 38 files. Let's construct correct mapping and call consolidate again.
